sanskrit_verse:
स्वयमुक्तेरनिर्दिष्टः स्वयमेवैत्य यो वदेत्‌ ।
मृतान्तरोऽर्थिनि प्रेते मुमूर्षुश्रावितादृते ॥
transliteration: svayamukter anirdiṣṭaḥ svayam evaitya yo vadet | mṛtāntaro 'rthini prete mumūrṣuśrāvitād ṛte ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who speaks on their own accord without being asked, except in matters concerning a deceased person's estate or a dying individual's wishes, incurs a disruption in the natural flow of dharma and consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from invocation, not self-assertion
Causation arises through conscious relevance, not arbitrary speech
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by alignment with dharmic necessity
Restoration logic requires realignment with invoked truth
Consciousness alignment occurs when speech serves the completion of karmic process
executable_legal_axioms: IF speaker initiates discourse WITHOUT prior invocation THEN flag as misaligned utterance
IF context involves deceased estate OR dying person's last wishes THEN ALLOW unsolicited speech
IF misaligned utterance detected THEN initiate consciousness-restoration protocol
IF utterance disrupts dharma-flow THEN assign completion-process to restore causal integrity
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, spontaneous declarations must be evaluated based on whether they serve a life-or-death interest or concern the final will of a dying person. Otherwise, such statements bypass legitimate invocation structures and require judicial restoration protocols rather than evidentiary weighting.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that uninvoked speech lacks grounding in dharma-process unless tied to terminal or posthumous interests. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how untethered words disturb sequential manifestation. Responsibility aligns proportionally with disruption level. The non-punitive reality rule enforces correction via consciousness reintegration rather than punitive silencing.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Speaker must fully articulate the reason for self-invocation until causal coherence is restored
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Speaker acknowledges role in disrupting dharma-flow and commits to alignment
Capacity Restoration: Meditate until clarity returns regarding when speech serves necessity versus ego-motion
Integrity Reintegration: Public reaffirmation of commitment to speak only upon invocation or in death-related exigencies
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling executes pure Dharma: Speech derives legitimacy only through invocation or existential urgency. All disruptions are resolved through consciousness restoration, not punishment. Reality remains non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
